verdict.rationale: Clerk documents default admin/member Roles plus custom Roles and fine-grained Permissions within Organizations, and says it provides the Organization context (memberships, Roles, Active Organization) in each session. Its session token is a JWT carrying user and session information, and its docs show tool calls being gated against the caller's Clerk permissions. A community report confirms roles are tied to organizations rather than stored on the user, so there is no global admin concept without using metadata. That limits scope but does not contradict the documented capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that roles/permissions appear as JWT claims, documented general-purpose enforcement helpers for app routes (beyond eve tool-call gating), user-level (non-org) roles, and independent hands-on corroboration.
